designerNotes: Excellent image quality throughout. Hero shot is a stunning dusk exterior with lotus fountain and elephant statues — world-class curb appeal. Indoor pool with green living wall is unique differentiator. Suite room has premium coffered LED ceiling — use prominently. All images enhanced: resized, brightness/saturation optimized, progressive JPEG.

logo.notes: Black & white ornate circular logo on white background. Use on dark backgrounds with CSS invert filter or white version. Elegant, traditional design.

hero_bg.description: Hotel exterior at dusk — 4-story building with lit lotus fountain, elephant statues, warm golden lighting. Stunning curb appeal.
hero_bg.notes: Use as hero background with dark gradient overlay for text readability. This is the money shot.

hero_bg_2.description: Same dusk exterior, slightly different angle — more sky visible.
hero_bg_2.notes: Use in About page or as hero slideshow second slide.

lobby.description: Elegant lobby seating area — two beige curved sofas, geometric glass coffee table, palm trees visible through glass.
lobby.notes: Warm, welcoming feel. Good for About/Welcome section.

lobby_2.description: Lobby alternate angle — similar beige sofas, hotel ambiance.

reception.description: Reception desk with warm pendant lighting, textured wall, 'Reception' signage visible.

pool.description: Indoor swimming pool — blue mosaic tiles, wooden ceiling with spotlights, green living wall feature, steel entry rails.
pool.notes: UNIQUE DIFFERENTIATOR — indoor pool is rare in Ujjain. Feature prominently in amenities and hero area. Living green wall makes it luxurious.

banquet_1.description: Large banquet hall with stage, balloon arch decor, rows of sofa seating, marble floor.
banquet_1.notes: Highlight 3 banquet halls as key selling point for weddings/events. Bright up with brightness 1.18.

room_deluxe.description: Deluxe room — wood-paneled king bed headboard, tray ceiling, TV, warm lighting.

room_super_deluxe.description: Super Deluxe room — AC, king bed with hotel-branded linen, wooden furniture, clean modern finish.

room_executive.description: Executive room — spacious with two queen beds, textured grey walls, cove lighting, mood illumination.
room_executive.notes: Map to Executive (₹5000). Two-bed layout appeals to families.

room_super_executive.description: Super Executive suite — coffered tray ceiling with LED cove lighting, lounge sofa, king bed with gold embroidered runner, full-length mirror, wooden wardrobe, kettle station.
room_super_executive.notes: FLAGSHIP ROOM — Map to Super Executive (₹6000). Premium finish rivals 5-star properties. Feature prominently.

colorPalette.note: Navy/midnight + gold — extracted from dusk exterior. Hotel has warm golden lighting throughout. Navy+Gold theme confirmed optimal.

designRecommendations: Hero: Use IMG_3882 (dusk exterior) full-bleed with dark gradient overlay — no text box needed, just overlay text
Indoor pool (living green wall) is the #1 unique selling point — give it a dedicated hero section, not just gallery
Suite room LED ceiling is premium quality — use as 'Super Executive' feature card with large image
Logo is B&W — use CSS filter: invert(1) on dark backgrounds to show white logo
Banquet halls: Show capacity + 3 hall USP prominently — many Ujjain hotels lack proper event facilities
All room photos have hotel-branded linen (embroidered logo) — this signals quality without needing text
Lobby palm trees through glass = tropical/resort vibe — use in 'Experience' section
